c5 c3 Nc6 Nf3 Qb6.en: The main line: ...c5, ...Nc6 and ...Qb6 all hit d4. Next come ...Bd7, ...Nge7–f5 or ...cxd4 with ...Bb4+ tricks.
c5 c3 Nc6 Nf3 Qb6.es: La línea principal: ...c5, ...Cc6 y ...Db6 atacan d4. Después llegan ...Ad7, ...Cge7–f5 o ...cxd4 con trucos de ...Ab4+.

c5 c3 Nc6 Be3 Qb6 b3 cxd4 cxd4 Bb4+ Bd2.en: ...Qxd4! and if Bxb4, ...Qxe5+ and ...Nxb4: Black wins material.
c5 c3 Nc6 Be3 Qb6 b3 cxd4 cxd4 Bb4+ Bd2.es: ¡...Dxd4! y si Axb4, ...Dxe5+ y ...Cxb4: las negras ganan material.

c5 c3 Nc6 Nf3 Qb6 b3 Bd7 Be3 cxd4 Nxd4.en: The e5-pawn has lost its support: ...Nxe5.
c5 c3 Nc6 Nf3 Qb6 b3 Bd7 Be3 cxd4 Nxd4.es: El peón de e5 ha perdido su apoyo: ...Cxe5.
